entities.summary: Lars Jönsson is a former tennis player from Sweden, who turned professional in 1988. He did not win any ATP title during his career, best result was a singles final in Wellington. The right-hander reached his highest individual ranking on the ATP Tour on 7 October 1991, when he became ranked 67th in the world.
